mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) can cause ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity, which may be potentiated by propranolol's effects on renal perfusion and clearance, particularly in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function and auditory function closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if renal impairment develops; verify appropriate amikacin dosing based on renal function.
